country.introSummary: {name} has {count} public holidays in {year}. Of these, {national} are national holidays celebrated nationwide and {regional} are regional observances.

country.faqAllNationalAnswer: {yesno}. {national} out of {count} holidays are national holidays.

country.faqLongWeekendsAnswer: You can plan {count} long weekends in {name} in {year}.

country.faqTodayYes: Yes — today ({date}) is {holiday}, a public holiday in {name}.
country.faqTodayNo: No. The next public holiday in {name} is {holiday} on {date}.
country.bankHolidayNote: Looking for {demonym} public holidays or {demonym} bank holidays? {name} public holidays — also called national holidays or non-working days — are observed nationwide and in some regions. Bridge days let you turn a single holiday into a long weekend.
country.holidayWeekendNote: A {name} holiday weekend happens when a public holiday falls on a Monday or Friday, creating a three-day weekend. The list above shows every long weekend and bridge-day opportunity in {year}.

longWeekend.none: No long weekends found for this year.

holidayDetail.multiDateNote: In {year}, {name} is observed on {count} separate dates in {country}.

holidayDetail.bridgeTakeFriday: {name} falls on a Thursday in {year}. Take the Friday off to turn it into a four-day weekend.
holidayDetail.bridgeMidweek: {name} falls on a Wednesday in {year}, splitting the week — there is no single bridge day this year.
holidayDetail.bridgeWeekend: {name} falls on the weekend in {year}, so it does not add an extra day off.

holidayDetail.faqScopeRegional: {name} is a regional public holiday in {country}, observed in {count} region(s) rather than the whole country.
holidayDetail.faqScopeUnknown: {name} is a public holiday in {country}; whether it is observed nationwide can vary by region.
holidayDetail.faqCountdownPast: {name} was on {date} and has already passed this year.
